label: Music thirty second duration context
adaptation_note: Counted 32-unit reference and one selected unit. The exact 1:32 relation is retained in counts; the original proportional length-bar version remains unchanged.
acceptance_requirement: Keep the exact 1:32 relationship but label the new sequence as a different encoding, not a faithful pair of proportional closed bars on sixty columns.

frames.title: Thirty-two equal duration units
frames.teaching_key: Read eight units per row, four rows in sequence. Together they represent the reference duration divided into 32 equal temporal units. No event is selected in this reference frame. This count encoding replaces the two exact length bars; the rows are continued temporal units, not simultaneous sounds, note notation, beats or tempo. No new common-scale length claim.

frames.title: Thirty-two equal duration units with one event selected
frames.teaching_key: Read eight units per row, four rows in sequence. Together they represent the reference duration divided into 32 equal temporal units. The first unit has a centre pin: that one unit is the event, one thirty-second of the whole reference. This count encoding replaces the two exact length bars; the rows are continued temporal units, not simultaneous sounds, note notation, beats or tempo. No new common-scale length claim.
